objective: Auditar readiness fisico SQL de Development para Production Quality / Foto Finish usando exclusivamente la conexion canonica READ_ONLY HRLectura. Verificar identidad de DB/login, objetos target, dependencias, tipos, FKs, indices, checks, RBAC fuente, acciones, cobertura de permisos y colisiones antes de ejecutar las migraciones certificadas Gate5D1/Gate5D2. No ejecutar DDL ni DML. No ejecutar migraciones. No tocar Produccion. No auto-advance a Gate5D4B.

queries.name: database_identity
queries.sql:
SELECT
    DB_NAME() AS database_name,
    @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,
    ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login,
    SUSER_SNAME() AS current_login,
    USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: current_session_permissions
queries.sql:
SELECT
    HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(), 'DATABASE', 'CONNECT') AS can_connect,
    HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(), 'DATABASE', 'CREATE TABLE') AS can_create_table,
    HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo', 'SCHEMA', 'ALTER') AS can_alter_dbo,
    HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(), 'DATABASE', 'CONTROL') AS has_database_control

queries.name: production_quality_objects
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects AS o
WHERE o.name IN (
    'Production_Item',
    'Production_Station',
    'Production_QualityStandard',
    'Production_QualityStandardVersion',
    'Production_Measurement',
    'Production_Evidence',
    'Production_QualityDecision',
    'Production_QualityAction',
    'Production_Device',
    'Production_DeviceCalibration'
)
ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: production_quality_columns
queries.sql:
SELECT
    o.name AS object_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    t.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity
FROM sys.objects AS o
JOIN sys.columns AS c
  ON c.object_id = o.object_id
JOIN sys.types AS t
  ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE o.name IN (
    'Production_Item',
    'Production_Station',
    'Production_QualityStandard',
    'Production_QualityStandardVersion',
    'Production_Measurement',
    'Production_Evidence',
    'Production_QualityDecision',
    'Production_QualityAction',
    'Production_Device',
    'Production_DeviceCalibration'
)
ORDER BY o.name, c.column_id

queries.name: production_quality_foreign_keys
queries.sql:
SELECT
    po.name AS parent_object,
    fk.name AS foreign_key_name,
    pc.name AS parent_column,
    ro.name AS referenced_object,
    rc.name AS referenced_column
FROM sys.foreign_keys AS fk
JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns AS fkc
  ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.objects AS po
  ON po.object_id = fk.parent_object_id
JOIN sys.columns AS pc
  ON pc.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id
 AND pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
JOIN sys.objects AS ro
  ON ro.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id
JOIN sys.columns AS rc
  ON rc.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id
 AND rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
WHERE po.name IN (
    'Production_Item',
    'Production_Station',
    'Production_QualityStandard',
    'Production_QualityStandardVersion',
    'Production_Measurement',
    'Production_Evidence',
    'Production_QualityDecision',
    'Production_QualityAction',
    'Production_Device',
    'Production_DeviceCalibration'
)
ORDER BY po.name, fk.name

queries.name: production_quality_indexes
queries.sql:
SELECT
    o.name AS object_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.is_primary_key,
    i.is_unique,
    i.type_desc
FROM sys.objects AS o
JOIN sys.indexes AS i
  ON i.object_id = o.object_id
WHERE o.name IN (
    'Production_Item',
    'Production_Station',
    'Production_QualityStandard',
    'Production_QualityStandardVersion',
    'Production_Measurement',
    'Production_Evidence',
    'Production_QualityDecision',
    'Production_QualityAction',
    'Production_Device',
    'Production_DeviceCalibration'
)
  AND i.name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY o.name, i.name

queries.name: production_quality_checks
queries.sql:
SELECT
    o.name AS object_name,
    cc.name AS constraint_name,
    cc.definition
FROM sys.check_constraints AS cc
JOIN sys.objects AS o
  ON o.object_id = cc.parent_object_id
WHERE o.name IN (
    'Production_Item',
    'Production_Station',
    'Production_QualityStandard',
    'Production_QualityStandardVersion',
    'Production_Measurement',
    'Production_Evidence',
    'Production_QualityDecision',
    'Production_QualityAction',
    'Production_Device',
    'Production_DeviceCalibration'
)
ORDER BY o.name, cc.name

queries.name: canonical_dependencies
queries.sql:
SELECT
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects AS o
WHERE o.schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('dbo')
  AND o.name IN (
    'Sistema_Empresas',
    'Unidades_Negocio',
    'Usuario_Catalogo',
    'Servidores',
    'Usuario_Modulos',
    'Usuario_Acciones',
    'Usuario_Roles',
    'Usuario_PermisosRolModulo'
)
ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: canonical_dependency_key_columns
queries.sql:
SELECT
    o.name AS object_name,
    c.name AS column_name,
    t.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity
FROM sys.objects AS o
JOIN sys.columns AS c
  ON c.object_id = o.object_id
JOIN sys.types AS t
  ON t.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE
       (o.name = 'Sistema_Empresas'
        AND c.name = 'EmpresaID')
    OR (o.name = 'Unidades_Negocio'
        AND c.name IN ('id','server_id','activo'))
    OR (o.name = 'Usuario_Catalogo'
        AND c.name IN ('UsuarioID','PublicUUID','Activo'))
    OR (o.name = 'Servidores'
        AND c.name IN ('id','activo'))
    OR (o.name = 'Usuario_Modulos'
        AND c.name IN ('ModuloID','ModuloPadreID','CodigoModulo','Activo'))
    OR (o.name = 'Usuario_Acciones'
        AND c.name IN ('AccionID','CodigoAccion','Activo'))
    OR (o.name = 'Usuario_Roles'
        AND c.name IN ('RolID','CodigoRol','NivelJerarquia','Activo'))
    OR (o.name = 'Usuario_PermisosRolModulo'
        AND c.name IN (
            'RolID',
            'ModuloID',
            'AccionID',
            'Permitido',
            'RestriccionPropietario',
            'RestriccionSucursal',
            'RequiereAutorizacion',
            'NivelAutorizacionRequerido',
            'Activo',
            'CreatedBy'
        ))
ORDER BY o.name, c.column_id

queries.name: rbac_source_modules
queries.sql:
SELECT
    ModuloID,
    CodigoModulo,
    NombreModulo,
    ModuloPadreID,
    EsVisibleMenu,
    RequiereAutorizacion,
    Activo
FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos
WHERE LOWER(CodigoModulo) IN (
    'tablajeria',
    'tablajeria.config',
    'auth'
)
ORDER BY CodigoModulo

queries.name: rbac_required_actions
queries.sql:
SELECT
    AccionID,
    CodigoAccion,
    NombreAccion,
    Activo
FROM dbo.Usuario_Acciones
WHERE UPPER(CodigoAccion) IN (
    'VER',
    'CREAR',
    'GESTIONAR',
    'AUTORIZAR',
    'CONFIGURAR',
    'ADMIN'
)
ORDER BY CodigoAccion

queries.name: rbac_source_permission_coverage
queries.sql:
SELECT
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS active_allowed_role_count
FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo AS prm
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos AS m
  ON m.ModuloID = prm.ModuloID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones AS a
  ON a.AccionID = prm.AccionID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles AS r
  ON r.RolID = prm.RolID
WHERE (
       (LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) = 'tablajeria'
        AND UPPER(a.CodigoAccion) IN (
            'VER',
            'CREAR',
            'AUTORIZAR'
        ))
    OR (LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) = 'tablajeria.config'
        AND UPPER(a.CodigoAccion) IN (
            'VER',
            'CONFIGURAR'
        ))
    OR (LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) = 'auth'
        AND UPPER(a.CodigoAccion) = 'ADMIN')
)
  AND ISNULL(prm.Activo, 1) = 1
  AND ISNULL(prm.Permitido, 0) = 1
  AND ISNULL(m.Activo, 1) = 1
  AND ISNULL(a.Activo, 1) = 1
  AND ISNULL(r.Activo, 1) = 1
GROUP BY
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion
ORDER BY
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion

queries.name: existing_production_quality_rbac
queries.sql:
SELECT
    ModuloID,
    CodigoModulo,
    NombreModulo,
    ModuloPadreID,
    EsVisibleMenu,
    RequiereAutorizacion,
    Activo
FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos
WHERE LOWER(CodigoModulo) LIKE 'production_quality%'
ORDER BY CodigoModulo

queries.name: existing_production_quality_permissions
queries.sql:
SELECT
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS permission_count
FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo AS prm
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos AS m
  ON m.ModuloID = prm.ModuloID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones AS a
  ON a.AccionID = prm.AccionID
WHERE LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) LIKE 'production_quality%'
GROUP BY
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion
ORDER BY
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion

queries.name: semantic_collision_objects
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects AS o
WHERE
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%production%quality%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%foto%finish%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%standard%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%decision%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%action%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%calibr%'
ORDER BY
    schema_name,
    object_name
